name: The Veil Spreads as Ash
description: Following the Guardian's defeat and the opening of the Gloomridge route, Veil-ash begins saturating the Old Road and Stoneward. Cult activity intensifies. Beasts flee inward. The ash falls on things that should not burn.

name: The Quarantine Line
description: Brightfall Council issues a quarantine order on Plague Fen after a second outbreak cluster. Iron Covenant checkpoints go up at the Crossroads approach. Movement slows. The Harvesters become harder to reach — and more expensive.

name: Ember Hollow Destabilizes
description: The second Veil fracture — the one the party either sealed or failed to seal in Act 1 — has widened. Ember Hollow is no longer the quiet approach it once was. The Sovereign's presence is felt at the edges of the region.

name: The Oathless Mobilize
description: Word of the party's actions in the Ash Plains has reached the informal Oathless network. Former Emberguard soldiers begin moving toward the Crossroads. Not organized — but present, and armed, and willing.

name: The Sovereign Reaches Forward
description: In Act 3, the Sovereign's influence extends beyond the Riftgate. The Architect's Verge begins showing signs of active Veil penetration. The final confrontation is no longer in one place — it is everywhere at once.
